open.title: The Administration building is wearing the wrong colours
open.body: Rivalry season has begun. Overnight, students from Sedgecroft College dressed the Administration building in their colours. It is, the Athletic Director admits, tidy work.

options.label: Leave it up for the week: $37,000 to clean it later
options.detail: Happiness is 1 point higher for two days. Students rather like it.

options.label: Fund an answer: $74,000
options.detail: A banner appears on their bridge. A tenth more fans want a ticket for two days.

open.title: Drinks at the tailgate?
open.body: The boosters ask whether fans of 21 and over may drink at the tailgate before the next home game. Campus Safety has views. So does the Medical Center.

options.label: Keep the tailgate dry
options.detail: Nothing changes. Grills, tents and a great deal of lemonade.

options.label: Allow drinks for fans of 21 and over, with ID checks: $49,500
options.detail: Ten in a hundred more fans want a ticket for three days. Calls from parties come twice as often for those three days.

open.title: Keep the Library open late
open.body: At the height of finals, Stress here would reach about 64 of 100. Students ask for the Library to stay open late until exams are over. The librarians ask for the same thing in fewer words.

options.label: Pay for late hours: $198,500
options.detail: Stress is 10 points lower for three days.
